text:
maria: quick ping — opened PR #4821 touching auth + vault paths for the on-prem agent, would like a quick security look before merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821 :wave:

dan: put the link in — on it. which parts are risky?

maria: mostly the change switches the agent to read a new vault path and conditionally use a customer KMS key. small surface: env var name, vault path, and a new bit that calls kms:decrypt when KMS_KEY is set. diff snippet:
```diff
- secret = os.getenv('AGENT_SECRET')
+ vault_path = os.getenv('AGENT_VAULT_PATH', 'secret/redwood/agent')
+ secret = vault.read(vault_path) or kms.decrypt(os.getenv('KMS_KEY'), vault.read(vault_path + '/enc'))
```

kevin: :eyes: ok. a few quick asks: 1) is the KMS key customer-provided or Redwood-managed? 2) do we log any ciphertext or key identifiers? 3) does on-prem flow ever attempt to call out to public KMS endpoints (egress)?

maria: 1) customer-provided if AGENT_KMS_KEY set, otherwise Redwood-managed. 2) no logging of ciphertext in code, but double-checking tests — removed a fixture earlier that accidentally included a mock key. 3) on-prem agent will call customer KMS endpoint only when configured; otherwise uses local unencrypted path. We need a code-level guard to avoid accidental egress.

kevin: please add an allowlist check, e.g., only call external KMS if AGENT_ALLOW_EGRESS=true and VPC config present. also add an audit log event when we choose to use external KMS.

tanvi: also verify secret scanning — did CI trufflehog/secret-scan run on this branch?

ci-bot: secret-scan: passed (trufflehog v2.1) — no high/medium findings. build: green. :white_check_mark:

dan: thanks — can you paste the PR link + one-line summary into the release checklist? we'll coordinate merge window.

maria: added summary to the checklist: "PR #4821 — on-prem agent: vault path + optional customer KMS; added allowlist for external KMS; removed test fixture with mock key."

kevin: I can give formal approval once the allowlist guard and audit event are in. also request an ops nod on egress rules for on-prem installs.

tanvi: ops ping: @ops-team can someone confirm that enabling AGENT_ALLOW_EGRESS will not bypass firewall rules for customers?

dan: ops reply pending; if no ops ack by EOD Thursday let's hold. otherwise target merge Friday 18:00 UTC (low-traffic) — is that OK?

maria: sounds good. I'll push a small follow-up commit for the allowlist + audit log today. tagging @kevin for final review after that. :thumbsup:

kevin: once updated I'll review quickly. if green and ops ok, +1 and you can merge. please don't force-merge without sec ack.

maria: noted. will wait for sec + ops. thanks all. :pray:

ci-bot: e2e-run queued on merge, will block merge until green.
